events.description: Lydia asks how Guy knew that Lydia was at the hospital.
Guy says Lydia's mom called Guy.
Guy asks whether the car in question is Lydia's mom's car.
Lydia says the car in question is a loaner.
Guy says Lydia had to handle the delivery by herself.
Lydia says Lydia was not by herself and that Lydia had a doctor (Person 1), a nurse (Person 2), and Joey Tribbiani helping.
Lydia asks whether Guy saw who won the game.
Guy says the New York Knicks are terrible.
Lydia says the New York Knicks are not so bad.
